name: Eleanor Seeker
source:
Eleanor was the only daughter of a New Jersey rancher, but her parents died in an accident. After that, a distant relative took her to Romania.
She tends to be shy, but once she opens her heart, she shows a bright and compassionate side.
Her sixth sense has been strong since she was a child.
